tour.ui.desktopOnlyNote: This panel is desktop-only. Open the site at 768px or wider to use it.
tour.ui.invite.title: Guided tour
tour.onboarding.title: First contact
tour.onboarding.nav.title: Module rail
tour.onboarding.nav.body: Nine MOM modules, keyboard 1-9. Each runs the same factory state, one discipline.
tour.onboarding.kpi.title: KPI strip
tour.onboarding.kpi.body: Six live metrics, recomputed every tick. Warning and danger bands come from the scenario manifest.
tour.onboarding.river.title: Event river
tour.onboarding.river.body: Every factory event drifts left as a chip. Alarms and violations pin to the priority lane at the head.
tour.onboarding.controls.title: Theme · language
tour.onboarding.controls.body: Dark for monitoring, light for reading. The language toggle redraws every label, including this card.
tour.onboarding.demo.title: Demo story
tour.onboarding.demo.body: Plays a 30-tick narrative following one lot through an excursion and recovery. Replay it anytime.
tour.onboarding.finish.title: You are oriented
tour.onboarding.finish.body: You can read the shell now. Follow a wafer end to end, or explore any module on your own.
tour.grand-tour.title: A wafer's journey
tour.grand-tour.erp-order.title: The order
tour.grand-tour.erp-order.body: Production starts here: a purchase order moves Draft → Received across the kanban. Everything downstream traces to it.
tour.grand-tour.erp-bom.title: Bill of materials
tour.grand-tour.erp-bom.body: Each product expands one level into the consumables and tool groups it consumes. This is what must be in stock to build it.
tour.grand-tour.aps-dispatch.title: Dispatch
tour.grand-tour.aps-dispatch.body: The planner assigns each lot to an equipment row across the epoch. Re-dispatch reshuffles the schedule deterministically.
tour.grand-tour.aps-load.title: Equipment load
tour.grand-tour.aps-load.body: The heatmap shows utilization across the fleet. Hot cells are where the schedule concentrates work.
tour.grand-tour.mes-lots.title: On the line
tour.grand-tour.mes-lots.body: Lot L-042 is now in process. The table tracks every lot's current step, equipment, and status each tick.
tour.grand-tour.mes-gantt.title: Lifecycle
tour.grand-tour.mes-gantt.body: The selected lot's route plays out as a gantt: completed steps, the live step, and what remains.
tour.grand-tour.recipe-versions.title: The recipe
tour.grand-tour.recipe-versions.body: Each step runs to a recipe: chamber, gas, time, temperature, pressure. Versions are signed off before they reach the line.
tour.grand-tour.wip-flow.title: Work in process
tour.grand-tour.wip-flow.body: Queue length per tool group, sampled every tick. Rising queues mark where the line is congested.
tour.grand-tour.spc-chart.title: Under control
tour.grand-tour.spc-chart.body: Chamber pressure is plotted against its control limits. A point beyond 3σ trips a violation — watch the red pulse.
tour.grand-tour.spc-rules.title: Western Electric
tour.grand-tour.spc-rules.body: Eight rules catch patterns a single point misses — runs, trends, stratification. Toggle each to see what it flags.
tour.grand-tour.apc-r2r.title: The correction
tour.grand-tour.apc-r2r.body: When pressure drifts, run-to-run control nudges the setpoint back. The four traces track the parameters it watches.
tour.grand-tour.yield-pareto.title: Yield impact
tour.grand-tour.yield-pareto.body: Defects ranked by type. The excursion shows up here as a taller bar — the loss the whole chain works to prevent.
tour.grand-tour.yield-wafer.title: Wafer map
tour.grand-tour.yield-wafer.body: Defect coordinates on a 300mm wafer. A cluster is a signature; scattered dots are random noise.
tour.grand-tour.scm-suppliers.title: Supply chain
tour.grand-tour.scm-suppliers.body: The material that built this wafer came from scored suppliers — on-time, quality, lead time. The loop closes back to the order.
tour.grand-tour.finish.title: Order to yield
tour.grand-tour.finish.body: You just followed lot L-042 from order to yield across all nine modules. Open any one to go deeper.
tour.tour-mes.title: MES workflow
tour.tour-mes.table.title: Lot table
tour.tour-mes.table.body: Every lot's live status, step, and equipment, updated each tick. Sort or filter to find one fast.
tour.tour-mes.select.title: Select a lot
tour.tour-mes.select.body: Clicking a row selects that lot and drives the lifecycle gantt below it. L-042 is selected here.
tour.tour-mes.gantt.title: Lifecycle gantt
tour.tour-mes.gantt.body: The selected lot's planned route, with completed, live, and pending steps colour-coded along the epoch.
tour.tour-mes.actions.title: Hold · scrap · complete
tour.tour-mes.actions.body: These actions write lot status directly. Hold expires after thirty ticks; scrap and complete are terminal.
tour.tour-mes.finish.title: MES, covered
tour.tour-mes.finish.body: Table, lifecycle, and the action set are the heart of execution. Every status change ripples to the KPI strip.
tour.tour-aps.title: APS workflow
tour.tour-aps.dispatch.title: Dispatch gantt
tour.tour-aps.dispatch.body: One hundred equipment rows; each active lot is placed on one with a start and end window inside the epoch.
tour.tour-aps.load.title: Load heatmap
tour.tour-aps.load.body: A ten-by-ten utilization grid. The hotter the cell, the more dispatch density it carries.
tour.tour-aps.redispatch.title: Re-dispatch
tour.tour-aps.redispatch.body: Re-dispatch and auto-balance reshuffle the schedule deterministically. Lock freezes it against further change.
tour.tour-aps.finish.title: APS, covered
tour.tour-aps.finish.body: Dispatch and load together answer one question: where does each lot run, and how busy is the fleet.
tour.tour-erp.title: ERP workflow
tour.tour-erp.bom.title: BOM tree
tour.tour-erp.bom.body: Five products, each expandable one level into its components and consumables. Click a product to drill in.
tour.tour-erp.kanban.title: PO kanban
tour.tour-erp.kanban.body: Five columns, Draft to Received. Cards advance left to right as material events arrive.
tour.tour-erp.create.title: Create a PO
tour.tour-erp.create.body: Create PO opens a form; the new card lands in Draft. Approve and Cancel move or remove it.
tour.tour-erp.finish.title: ERP, covered
tour.tour-erp.finish.body: The BOM defines what to buy; the kanban tracks the buying. Together they feed the line upstream.
tour.tour-spc.title: SPC workflow
tour.tour-spc.chart.title: Control chart
tour.tour-spc.chart.body: The X-bar plots each subgroup mean against UCL, CL, and LCL. Zones at one, two, and three sigma frame the rules.
tour.tour-spc.rules.title: WE rules
tour.tour-spc.rules.body: Eight Western Electric rules, each toggling independently with a live hit count. A point trips if any enabled rule flags it.
tour.tour-spc.rchart.title: Range chart
tour.tour-spc.rchart.body: The R chart tracks within-subgroup spread. Mean drift and spread drift are different faults — both must stay in control.
tour.tour-spc.vlog.title: Violation log
tour.tour-spc.vlog.body: Every flagged point lands here with its rule, value, and Open status. This is the queue an engineer acknowledges.
tour.tour-spc.finish.title: SPC, covered
tour.tour-spc.finish.body: Chart, rules, range, and log are one loop: detect a drift, name the rule, log it, act before it reaches yield.
tour.tour-apc.title: APC workflow
tour.tour-apc.r2r.title: Run-to-run
tour.tour-apc.r2r.body: The R2R series is the correction applied to each run, holding the process at its setpoint over the recent window.
tour.tour-apc.controller.title: EWMA · PID
tour.tour-apc.controller.body: Switching the controller changes the smoothing formula, so the correction curve reshapes. PID exposes Kp, Ki, Kd.
tour.tour-apc.fdc.title: Fault detection
tour.tour-apc.fdc.body: Four parameter traces — pressure, RF power, gas flow, temperature — watched in parallel for excursions.
tour.tour-apc.finish.title: APC, covered
tour.tour-apc.finish.body: Where SPC detects, APC corrects. Run-to-run closes the loop so a drift never compounds into scrap.
tour.tour-wip.title: WIP workflow
tour.tour-wip.gantt.title: Lot board
tour.tour-wip.gantt.body: Every lot's progress at a glance: queued slivers, running bars, held lots, completed lots — all on one board.
tour.tour-wip.flow.title: Flow diagram
tour.tour-wip.flow.body: Eight tool groups as a pipeline; each dot is a lot, travelling the edge as it transitions between steps.
tour.tour-wip.queue.title: Queue sparklines
tour.tour-wip.queue.body: Queue length per tool group over time. A climbing line marks a bottleneck forming before it stalls the line.
tour.tour-wip.finish.title: WIP, covered
tour.tour-wip.finish.body: Board, flow, and queues show the same lots three ways — where they are, where they move, where they pile up.
tour.tour-scm.title: SCM workflow
tour.tour-scm.scorecard.title: Supplier scorecard
tour.tour-scm.scorecard.body: Ten suppliers, each graded on on-time delivery, quality, and lead time. The LED reflects the weaker of the two scores.
tour.tour-scm.transit.title: In transit
tour.tour-scm.transit.body: Material en route to the fab, with supplier, quantity, and ETA. Rows arrive over time as the simulation advances.
tour.tour-scm.receive.title: Receive · reject · escalate
tour.tour-scm.receive.body: Each in-transit row can be received, rejected, or escalated. Receiving slides it out and confirms the material landed.
tour.tour-scm.finish.title: SCM, covered
tour.tour-scm.finish.body: The scorecard rates who supplies; the transit table tracks what is arriving. This is where the order chain began.
tour.tour-recipe.title: Recipe workflow
tour.tour-recipe.params.title: Parameter table
tour.tour-recipe.params.body: The selected version's steps: chamber, gas, time, temperature, pressure. This is the exact process the tools run.
tour.tour-recipe.newversion.title: New version
tour.tour-recipe.newversion.body: New version derives a deterministic delta off the current head and queues it for approval. The diff reveals what changed.
tour.tour-recipe.diff.title: Version diff
tour.tour-recipe.diff.body: Two versions side by side; changed cells are flagged amber for the old value, green for the new.
tour.tour-recipe.signoff.title: Sign off
tour.tour-recipe.signoff.body: Sign off approves a pending version and emits a recipe change. APC re-aligns its setpoint and MES tags the route.
tour.tour-recipe.finish.title: Recipe, covered
tour.tour-recipe.finish.body: Parameters, versions, diff, sign-off: a recipe never reaches a tool unreviewed. Changes propagate across the line.
tour.tour-yield.title: Yield workflow
tour.tour-yield.pareto.title: Defect pareto
tour.tour-yield.pareto.body: Defects ranked by type, tallest first. The few types at the head account for most of the loss — fix those first.
tour.tour-yield.wafer.title: Wafer map
tour.tour-yield.wafer.body: Defect coordinates on a 300mm wafer with ring and notch. A clustered signature points to a process cause.
tour.tour-yield.trend.title: Yield trend
tour.tour-yield.trend.body: Rolling yield across recent lots against the alert threshold. A line crossing below it raises a yield alert.
tour.tour-yield.drilldown.title: Drill down
tour.tour-yield.drilldown.body: Clicking a pareto bar opens that defect type's contributing lots — one level, from the type to the lots behind it.
tour.tour-yield.finish.title: Yield, covered
tour.tour-yield.finish.body: Pareto, wafer map, trend, and drill-down turn raw defects into a cause. This is where the whole chain is judged.
guide.title: Guide Hub
guide.kiosk.title: Auto-play everything
guide.kiosk.body: Plays the orientation, then the full wafer journey, hands-free.
guide.how.1.title: What this site is
guide.how.1.body: A working model of a semiconductor fab's manufacturing operations — nine MOM systems running one shared, deterministic factory in the browser. No backend, no build step.
guide.how.2.title: The tick engine
guide.how.2.body: Time advances in one-second ticks. Every value is recomputed from a seeded pseudo-random stream, so the same load always produces the same run — fully replayable, never noisy.
guide.how.3.title: The nine modules
guide.how.3.body: The production flow runs ERP → APS → MES → SPC → APC → WIP → SCM → Recipe → Yield: order, plan, execute, control, track, supply, configure, and judge — the full path from purchase order to yield.
guide.how.4.title: The event river
guide.how.4.body: Every factory event drifts across the top as a chip. Alarms, SPC violations, and defects pin to the priority lane at the head so the urgent never scrolls away.
guide.how.5.title: Instrument-grade design
guide.how.5.body: The visual language is a calibrated instrument, not a flashy dashboard: hairline grids, a single cyan accent for live data, semantic colour reserved for status. Restraint is the point.
guide.how.6.title: Keyboard and themes
guide.how.6.body: Keys 1-9 jump between modules. Two themes — dark for monitoring, light for reading — and two languages, with every label redrawn on switch.
guide.how.7.title: The tour system
guide.how.7.body: These tours spotlight a real panel, explain its workflow, and advance at your pace. Reset progress anytime, or deep-link straight to a tour.
